release_notes: Tachyon AIO v0.45.46 replaces the Generator group's native wails.localhost prompt with a Tachyon-native in-app modal matching the Tasks group creator. The Generator modal includes Walmart, Target, and Amazon retailer selection, retailer search, an inline group-name field, Cancel/Add controls, Enter submit, Escape/backdrop close, and in-app duplicate-group feedback. Chromium regression coverage opens the real Generator modal, creates a Target Generator group, verifies it appears in the Generator tree, and rejects any native browser or WebView dialog.
